company.name: Outbound Sales Pro
company.one_liner: Outsourced SDR agency that fills B2B pipeline through multi-channel outbound (email, LinkedIn, cold calls, web visitor ID) — qualified meetings on your calendar at a fraction of the cost of an in-house SDR hire.
value_props: Qualified meetings booked directly onto your calendar — no managing SDRs
Reply rates 4.5x above industry average via Parakeet email infrastructure
Multi-channel outreach (email + LinkedIn + cold calls + web visitor ID) yields 3-5x more live conversations than single-channel
First meetings within 2-4 weeks of ramp; results compound from there
60-second SLA on real-time intro calls when a prospect lands on your site (35% conversion rate)
Pipeline at a fraction of the cost of a single $80-120k SDR hire — no headcount risk, no 6-month ramp
Market validation built in: every campaign surfaces objections, messaging signals, and ICP refinements you can use across GTM
differentiators: Proprietary Parakeet email infrastructure — deliverability protection at scale
Human callers blended with AI-assisted research and prioritization
Website visitor de-anonymization plus 60-second human follow-up call
G2 5.0 rated; 9+ month average client tenure
1 in 4 clients expand their investment within 6 months
Hundreds of qualified demos booked weekly across the book

target_tech_stack_signals: Instantly, Smartlead, or Parakeet (tried DIY cold email)

top_pain_points: Pipeline is unpredictable — relying on referrals and inbound that don't scale
Can't justify an $80-120k SDR hire with 6-month ramp and high attrition risk
Founder is doing sales themselves and it's not their zone of genius
Tried DIY cold email and either burned the domain, got no replies, or both
Existing AEs have no pipeline to work
Board / investor pressure to grow but no clear plan to get there
Marketing generates some leads but nobody is qualifying or following up systematically
common_objections: We've tried outsourced SDRs before and they sent generic spam
Nobody will understand our product as well as we do
I'd rather hire in-house so I own the talent and process
Cold outbound is dead — nobody opens these emails anymore
We're too early — still figuring out our ICP
Too expensive for where we are right now
Don't want to lock into a long contract
We just need lead lists, not a full service

positive_signals: Raised seed, Series A, or Series B funding in the last 6 months
Active SDR, BDR, or AE job posting on LinkedIn or company careers page
Recently hired VP Sales, Head of Sales, or CRO (last 90 days)
Hired CMO or marketing lead but no SDR function visible on team
New product launch or new market expansion in the last 90 days
Founder posting on LinkedIn about pipeline, GTM, scaling sales, or hiring SDRs
Headcount growth of 25% or more year over year
Company size between 10 and 100 employees on LinkedIn
Rebrand, website refresh, or repositioning in the last 6 months
Has Salesforce or HubSpot in tech stack
Using Apollo, ZoomInfo, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator (sales-conscious but undermanned)
disqualifiers: Over 250 employees (will build SDR team in-house)
Under 10 employees (too early, no budget for outbound)
B2C, DTC, or e-commerce business model
Series C or later, or publicly traded
Three or more SDRs already visible on LinkedIn
Agency selling primarily to other agencies
No website or website still listed as "coming soon"
Manufacturing or heavy industry with no B2B SaaS angle
